name: sunset-notice
title: Sunset Notice
description: Reads Sunset (RFC 8594) and Deprecation (RFC 9745) headers and their Link relations, lists what stops working, shows when in the reader's zone (flagging a different day than the UTC date), turns amber then red, and snoozes only until the next 30/7/1-day mark.

meta.stops: API shutdown arrives as an outage
meta.summary: Turns Sunset and Deprecation response headers into a visible countdown, so an API shutdown isn't a surprise outage.
catches: Sunset and Deprecation dates from response headers
Sunset earlier than deprecation, or already past
A local date that differs from the header's UTC date
Migration and policy links from Link rel=deprecation/sunset
limits: Sunset timestamps are hints; the API can stop earlier or later
Snooze state lives in localStorage on this device
Accepts legacy "Deprecation: true" with no date
a11y: Banner is a region with an aria-label; status is role=status, or role=alert once past
Snooze and migrate are labelled actions; icons are aria-hidden

sources.label: RFC 8594 – The Sunset HTTP Header Field
RFC 9745 – The Deprecation HTTP Response Header Field

rules.note: Confirmed: Sunset = HTTP-date with rel="sunset" links; Deprecation is a Structured Field date (e.g. @1688169599).
